name: Lee Jinchu
source:
Lee Jinchu is a maid of the Kuki family and a former assassin. She was hired to kill [url=/c56314]Mikado[/url] of Kuki Group but was caught by [url=/c9889]Claudio[/url]; after that, she was given a second chance at Kuki Group. Jinchu is trained in Chinese martial arts and Chinese kempo which makes her an expert in combat, with weapons or without them.

Jinchu is usually a very quiet and cool person, but is shown to be genuinely kind and caring, particularly to [url=/c3885]Yamato[/url] during the Kuki related routes ([url=/c5322]Monshiro[/url], [url=/c9791]Azumi[/url], etc.). Together with [url=/c9887]Stacy[/url], they often perform tasks as a team. She often corrects things if Stacy does something wrong. She also likes to tell jokes, make puns and play dead. 

She is currently ranked #16 between the maids and butlers of the Kuki Group.

[Edited from [url=http://majikoi.wikia.com/wiki/Jinchu_Lee]Majikoi Wiki[/url]]
